chunks: This was so because they said to those who disdain what God has revealed: 'We shall obey you in some things.' But God knows their secret intentions well.

key_terms.ذَٰلِكَ: This (referring to a previous context or state)

ai.seo_question: Why did the hypocrites say they would obey the disbelievers in some matters?
ai.summary: This verse elucidates the strategic alliance of the Munafiqun (hypocrites) with the disbelievers, noting their selective compliance in matters that did not compromise their core identity. It underscores God's omniscience regarding their concealed motives, a theme frequently cited by Shia exegetes to illustrate the duality of their public piety and private dissent.
